fullDescription: High-end fresh mini-program message interface featuring IP-mascot integration, pastel gradients, and soft rounded aesthetics. Ideal for campus communities, social networking, student services, or lifestyle apps. Uses a palette of vibrant blues, greens, and pinks with substantial white space, floating animations, and high-quality iconography. Key features include an overlapping header with a mascot profile, quick-action notification icons, and sophisticated message list cards with subtle drop shadows and border-radius-heavy geometry.

structured.summary: A clean, modern, and energetic mobile message center design using a light theme with soft gradients, rounded UI elements (24px+), and a character-centric header. The layout features a two-part structure: a decorative pastel top area and a white content area that overlaps the header, creating a layered, depth-rich feel.

style.description: The style is defined by a 'Rounded-Minimalist' aesthetic with IP-character branding. Typography uses 'Nunito' for a friendly, approachable feel. Color palette: Brand Blue (#0066CC), Brand Green (#00CC88), and soft background pastels like #F0F9FF. It utilizes subtle floating animations (8px vertical travel) and soft shadows (rgba(0,102,204,0.03)) to create a high-end feel.
style.prompt: Design a mobile interface with a 'Fresh & Premium' theme. Use 'Nunito' as the primary font family. Background color: #F0F9FF. Primary gradients: linear-gradient(135deg, #00CC88 0%, #0066CC 100%). Button/Icon backgrounds should use soft pastels: #FFF0F5 (Pink), #F0F7FF (Blue), #F0FFF6 (Green). Implement rounded corners with a radius of 24px for cards and 20px for avatars. Animations: Apply a floating up/down animation (3-4s duration, 8px offset) to key decorative elements. Active states: scale(0.98) transition for interactive cards. Icons: Use Lucide-style thin-stroke icons in high-contrast colors (#FF7A9A, #5C9DFF, #3BC26A).

layout_and_structure.description: A vertical scrollable layout with a 240px tall decorative header that uses absolute positioning for a mascot/IP image. A main content area overlaps the header by 24px and contains a message feed.

prompts.prompt: Height 240px with a gradient from #E8F9F5 to #E3F2FF. Place a large title '消息中心' (22px, font-extrabold) at top-left. Include a search icon and bell icon at the top-right. Add a row of four circular action buttons (45-50px size) with labels underneath for 'Likes', 'Followers', 'Comments', and 'System'. At the bottom, add a dual-layer SVG wave with #F0F9FF color and 0.6 opacity to transition into the body.

Positioned at the bottom-right of the header, partially overlapping the wave. A circular container (68px) with a 3px white border and a soft blue shadow [0_8px_20px_rgba(0,102,204,0.08)]. Apply a 'float-anim-delayed' vertical oscillation.
Z-index 20 with a negative top margin (-24px) to overlap the header wave. Padding: 16px horizontally. Messages are arranged as a stack of cards with 14px (space-y-3.5) vertical spacing between them.

Background white (#FFFFFF), padding 16px, border-radius 24px. Each card contains: a left-aligned avatar (56px, 20px radius), a middle section with a bold title (16px) and a preview message (13px, color #64748b), and a right-aligned timestamp (11-12px) or notification badge.

special_ui_components.description: A standout message card for official notifications with a gradient border and verification badge.
special_ui_components.prompt: The avatar container (56px) has a 2px padding and a linear-gradient border (#00CC88 to #0066CC). The title includes a 'lucide:check-circle-2' icon in #00CC88. Includes a 'Just now' badge in #F0F9FF with blue text #0066CC. Card shadow should be slightly stronger than regular cards.

special_ui_components.description: Floating navigation icons in the header for quick categorization.
special_ui_components.prompt: Size 45-50px. Background colors correspond to category: Pink (#FFF0F5), Light Blue (#F0F7FF), Mint (#F0FFF6). Radius 18px (Squircle shape). Icons are centered, 24px size. Red notification dots (#FF4D4D) are placed at the top-right of the icons with a 2px white border.
